title: FAST-DeepONet: Factor-Augmented Branch Representations for High-Dimensional PDE Inputs in the Small-Sample Regime
abstract: arXiv:2608.15408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep operator networks can become statistically unstable when partial differential equation inputs are observed at thousands of strongly correlated sensors but only a small number of operator samples is available. We introduce FAST-DeepONet, a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with a regularized projection of the orthogonal residual, in which the directional penalty acts on the effective residual map after each of its rows is normalized. On Navier--Stokes flow a plain DeepONet degrades from $0.0394$ to $0.1556$ mean relative $L_2$ error as the branch grows from $129$ to $8193$ coordinates, while FAST-DeepONet stays near $0.04$, so the sensor grid can be refined without a statistical penalty. Across independent test sets for Navier--Stokes flow, Darcy flow, and signed terminal wavefield prediction it lowers mean relative $L_2$ error by $4.7\%$ to $37.0\%$ with three to seven times fewer trainable parameters. translated_title: FAST-DeepONet：面向小样本高维偏微分方程输入的因子增强分支表示
translated_abstract: 深度算子网络在偏微分方程输入来自数千个强相关传感器但仅有少量算子样本时，可能会变得统计不稳定。我们提出了FAST-DeepONet，一种分支表示方法，它结合了固定谱路径和正交残差的正则化投影，其中方向性惩罚作用于每行归一化后的有效残差映射。在Navier-Stokes流中，当分支从129个坐标增长到8193个坐标时，普通DeepONet的平均相对L2误差从0.0394恶化到0.1556，而FAST-DeepONet保持在0.04附近，因此传感器网格可以在没有统计惩罚的情况下进行细化。在Navier-Stokes流、Darcy流和符号终端波场预测的独立测试集上，它平均相对L2误差降低了4.7%至37.0%，且可训练参数减少了三到七倍。一种谱...
tldr: 提出了一种结合固定谱路径与正则化正交残差投影的FAST-DeepONet分支表示方法，显著提高了高维传感器输入下小样本深度算子网络的稳定性与精度，同时大幅减少参数量。
en_tdlr: FAST-DeepONet introduces a branch representation combining a fixed spectral path with regularized orthogonal residual projection, markedly improving stability and accuracy of deep operator networks under high-dimensional sensor inputs with small samples while substantially reducing parameter counts.
